name: @arker-ai/sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for Arker virtual machines.

scripts.build:sdk: bun run generate:validators && tsup src/index.ts src/daytona.ts src/e2b.ts src/modal.ts src/blaxel.ts --format esm,cjs --dts --clean --target=node18
scripts.test: bun run generate:validators && bun test tests/typed-errors.test.ts tests/execution-model.test.ts tests/api-keys.test.ts && bun run test:port && bun tests/unit.ts && bun tests/compat.ts && bun tests/compat-router.ts && bun tests/compat-coverage.ts && bun run build && bun tests/http2.ts && bun run test:consumer
scripts.test:port: bun build tests/port-stream.test.ts --target=node --external=ws --outfile=node_modules/.cache/port-tests.cjs --format=cjs && node node_modules/.cache/port-tests.cjs && bun test tests/port-stream.test.ts && bun run test:private-fetch && bun run test:e2b-handles
scripts.test:compat-handles: bun build tests/e2b-command-handle.test.ts tests/e2b-lifecycle.test.ts tests/e2b-staging.test.ts tests/blaxel-provider.test.ts tests/daytona-provider.test.ts tests/modal-provider.test.ts tests/modal-command.test.ts tests/modal-filesystem.test.ts tests/guest-process-input.test.ts --target=node --external=e2b --external=@blaxel/core --external=@daytona/sdk --external=modal --outdir=node_modules/.cache/compat-tests --root=tests --format=cjs && node node_modules/.cache/compat-tests/e2b-command-handle.test.js && node node_modules/.cache/compat-tests/e2b-lifecycle.test.js && node node_modules/.cache/compat-tests/e2b-staging.test.js && node node_modules/.cache/compat-tests/blaxel-provider.test.js && node node_modules/.cache/compat-tests/daytona-provider.test.js && node node_modules/.cache/compat-tests/modal-provider.test.js && node node_modules/.cache/compat-tests/modal-command.test.js && node node_modules/.cache/compat-tests/modal-filesystem.test.js && node node_modules/.cache/compat-tests/guest-process-input.test.js
